Gaps

Not built yet

  • Payments. Nothing moves money. After "Accept" the chat just says "Deal done."
  • After the deal. No "delivered" or "posted" step, no reviews, nothing if a creator never posts.
  • Editing your profile. No way to change bio, picture or cover photo after sign-up.
  • Deleting a post.
  • Phone notifications. Job updates and offers show inside the app (Inbox), but don't buzz your phone yet.
  • Reporting and blocking.
  • Leaving a rating. Ratings are stored and shown, but there's no screen to leave one after a deal yet.

How it works

Location

  • The app asks for location permission the first time you open it after signing in.
  • If allowed, it saves a rough location (within about half a mile) on your profile and refreshes it each time you open the app.
  • It drives "Nearby", Map distances and the ranking boost for close posts.
  • Businesses with a verified Google listing are never asked; their address is used.
  • Demo mode: more than 30 miles from Seattle, the sample location is kept so the demo still has spots nearby.
